# Meter

`ui.meter` · parts: `Meter` · elements: `<meter>`

## Purpose

Meter is a native gauge for a known range (value/min/max).

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Meter yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Meter renders a native meter; children are the fallback text.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Value` | `value` | `value` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Min` | `min` | `min` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Max` | `max` | `max` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Low` | `low` | `low` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `High` | `high` | `high` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Optimum` | `optimum` | `optimum` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaLabel` | `aria-label` | `aria-label` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-label` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-label` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `meterClasses({ ... })` from `meter/meter.shared.ts` |
| templ | `meter.MeterClasses(meter.MeterProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('meterClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::meterClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `meter_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<meter>Content</meter>` |
| full | `{"Value":"0.6","Min":"0","Max":"1","Low":"0.2","High":"0.8","Optimum":"0.5","AriaLabel":"Disk"}` | `<meter value="0.6" min="0" max="1" low="0.2" high="0.8" optimum="0.5" aria-label="Disk">Content</meter>` |

## Usage

Fixture `full` (`{"Value":"0.6","Min":"0","Max":"1","Low":"0.2","High":"0.8","Optimum":"0.5","AriaLabel":"Disk"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<meter value="0.6" min="0" max="1" low="0.2" high="0.8" optimum="0.5" aria-label="Disk">Content</meter>
```

```tsx
import { Meter } from "./ui/meter/meter";

<Meter value="0.6" min="0" max="1" low="0.2" high="0.8" optimum="0.5" aria-label="Disk">Content</Meter>
```
